add-top-level-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Top-Level Bookmark to PDF
add-top-level-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, creates a top‑level bookmark named "Introduction" that points to the first page, and saves the updated document as a new file.

add-chapter-one-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Chapter One Bookmark to PDF
add-chapter-one-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a top‑level bookmark that points to page 5, and saving the updated document.

add-child-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Child Bookmark to Existing PDF
add-child-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, finds the "Chapter One" outline item, creates a child bookmark "Section 1.1" that jumps to page 6, and saves the result as a new file.

remove-all-bookmarks-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove All Bookmarks from a PDF
remove-all-bookmarks-from-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, clear its outline collection to delete all bookmarks, and save the modified document.

delete-pdf-bookmark-by-title.title: Delete a PDF Bookmark by Title
delete-pdf-bookmark-by-title.description: Shows how to load a PDF, remove a bookmark with a specific title using OutlineCollection.Delete, and save the modified document.

extract-pdf-bookmark-titles.title: Extract PDF Bookmark Titles to Text File
extract-pdf-bookmark-titles.description: Loads a PDF, recursively traverses its outline (bookmarks) and writes each bookmark title to a text file while leaving the PDF unchanged.

retrieve-bookmark-destination-page-numbe.title: Retrieve Bookmark Destination Page Number and Save to Text File
retrieve-bookmark-destination-page-numbe.description: Loads a PDF, searches for the bookmark named "Chapter One", extracts its destination page number (handling explicit and action‑based destinations), and writes the page number to a text file without modifying the PDF.

extract-child-bookmarks.title: Extract Child Bookmarks of a Specific Parent
extract-child-bookmarks.description: Loads a PDF, locates the bookmark named "Introduction" and writes the titles of its direct child bookmarks to a text file, leaving the PDF unchanged.

update-pdf-bookmark-title__v2.title: Update PDF Bookmark Title
update-pdf-bookmark-title__v2.description: Loads a PDF, retrieves the first top‑level bookmark, changes its title to "Preface", and saves the modified document.

update-bookmark-destination.title: Modify PDF Bookmark Destination
update-bookmark-destination.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, accessing a bookmark by its index, changing its destination to a specific page using XYZExplicitDestination, and saving the updated document.

update-first-section-title.title: Update First Section Title Under Chapter One in a Tagged PDF
update-first-section-title.description: Loads a tagged PDF, finds the header element "Chapter One", changes the text of its first child element, and saves the document as a new file.

expand-all-bookmarks.title: Expand All Bookmarks in a PDF
expand-all-bookmarks.description: Loads a PDF, recursively sets the Open property of every bookmark (outline) to true, and saves the result as a new file with all bookmarks expanded.

add-top-level-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add Top-Level Bookmarks to PDF
add-top-level-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: The example loads an existing PDF, creates three top‑level outline items (bookmarks) that navigate to pages 3, 15, and 27, and saves the modified document as a new file.

add-figure-bookmark-under-appendix-a.title: Add Figure Bookmark under Appendix A
add-figure-bookmark-under-appendix-a.description: Loads a PDF, ensures a parent bookmark named "Appendix A" exists, adds a child bookmark "Figure 1" that points to page 23, and saves the modified file.

reset-pdf-bookmarks-add-new-bookmark.title: Reset PDF Bookmarks and Add a New Top-Level Bookmark
reset-pdf-bookmarks-add-new-bookmark.description: The example loads a PDF, removes all existing bookmarks (outlines), creates a new top-level bookmark pointing to page 1, and saves the result as a new file.

replace-bookmark-add-child.title: Replace a Bookmark and Add a Child Bookmark in PDF
replace-bookmark-add-child.description: Loads a PDF, removes an existing bookmark, then creates a new child bookmark under a parent outline that points to page 4, and saves the modified document.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json__v2.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to JSON
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json__v2.description: Loads a PDF, traverses its outline (bookmarks) to collect each title and destination, and writes the data to a JSON file while leaving the PDF unchanged.

add-glossary-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Glossary Bookmark to PDF
add-glossary-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a top‑level bookmark that points to page 45, setting it to open on launch, and saving the result.

add-parent-child-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add Parent-Child Bookmarks to PDF
add-parent-child-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it has at least 51 pages, creates a parent bookmark "Index" on page 50 and a child bookmark "A-Z" on page 51 using XYZExplicitDestination, and saves the result as index.pdf.

count-top-level-bookmarks.title: Count Top-Level Bookmarks in PDF
count-top-level-bookmarks.description: Loads a PDF file, retrieves the number of top‑level bookmarks (outlines) and writes that count to a text file while leaving the PDF unchanged.

retrieve-child-bookmark-count.title: Retrieve Child Bookmark Count from PDF
retrieve-child-bookmark-count.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating a top‑level bookmark named "Chapter One", counting its direct child bookmarks, and writing the count to a text file while leaving the PDF unchanged.

add-expanded-child-bookmark-under-introd.title: Add Expanded Child Bookmark under Introduction
add-expanded-child-bookmark-under-introd.description: Loads a PDF, finds the "Introduction" bookmark, adds a child bookmark named "Note" with the Open property set to true, and saves the result as a new file.

update-pdf-bookmark-destination.title: Update PDF Bookmark Destination
update-pdf-bookmark-destination.description: Loads a PDF, finds a bookmark named "References", changes its destination to page 48, and saves the modified file.

rename-child-bookmark-pdf.title: Rename a Child Bookmark in a PDF
rename-child-bookmark-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a top‑level bookmark and its child, rename the child bookmark, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

expand-bookmarks-delete-appendix-a.title: Expand All Bookmarks and Delete a Specific Bookmark
expand-bookmarks-delete-appendix-a.description: The example loads a PDF, expands every bookmark in the outline tree, removes the bookmark titled "Appendix A", and saves the result as a new file.

add-top-level-bookmark-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Top-Level Bookmark to PDF
add-top-level-bookmark-to-pdf__v2.description: Loads a PDF, creates a top‑level bookmark named "Chapter Three" that points to page 60, and saves the result as a new file.

add-child-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.title: Add Child Bookmark to PDF Outline
add-child-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.description: Shows how to locate an existing bookmark in a PDF, create a child bookmark that points to a specific page, set it to be expanded, and save the updated document.

extract-top-level-bookmark-page-numbers.title: Extract Top-Level Bookmark Page Numbers from PDF
extract-top-level-bookmark-page-numbers.description: Loads a PDF, reads the page number of each top‑level bookmark (outline) and writes those numbers to a text file while leaving the PDF unchanged.

add-delete-top-level-bookmark.title: Add and Delete a Top-Level PDF Bookmark
add-delete-top-level-bookmark.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a top‑level bookmark on a specific page with the Open flag set, removing the same bookmark, and saving the modified document.

add-top-level-bookmark-export-outline.title: Add Top-Level Bookmark and Export Outline Hierarchy
add-top-level-bookmark-export-outline.description: Demonstrates how to add a top‑level bookmark pointing to page 2, set it to open on document load, and export the entire bookmark hierarchy to a text file.

add-update-top-level-bookmark.title: Add and Update a Top-Level Bookmark in a PDF
add-update-top-level-bookmark.description: Demonstrates how to create a top‑level bookmark (outline) on the first page of a PDF, modify its title, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-add-pdf-bookmark.title: Delete and Add Top-Level Bookmark in PDF
delete-add-pdf-bookmark.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, remove an existing bookmark, create a new top‑level bookmark that points to the first page, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

open-child-bookmarks-under-chapter-one.title: Open Child Bookmarks Under a Specific Bookmark
open-child-bookmarks-under-chapter-one.description: Loads a PDF, finds the bookmark titled "Chapter One", sets the Open property of all its direct child bookmarks to true, and saves the result as a new file.

count-pdf-bookmarks.title: Count PDF Bookmarks and Save Total
count-pdf-bookmarks.description: Loads a PDF, recursively counts all outline bookmarks, and writes the total number to a text file while leaving the PDF unchanged.

add-top-level-bookmark-to-pdf__v3.title: Add Top-Level Bookmark to PDF
add-top-level-bookmark-to-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a top‑level bookmark that navigates to page 1, and save the modified document.
